memories_after: [Fact w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-2 {"project":"docs"}) Project rule for the docs project: every team document placed in deliverables/ or reports/ must have its first line exactly 'Owner: <team-name>'; the team name string to use is 'docs-team' per project convention, even though get_team may report a different team label such as 'eval-agent (solo)'.

[Fact w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-2 {"project":"docs"}) In the docs project, documents under deliverables/ and reports/ use 'Owner: docs-team' as their first line; the existing deliverables/hello.txt follows this convention.

[Lesson w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) When creating or editing any document in deliverables/ or reports/ in the docs project, write the 'Owner: <team-name>' header as the first line before submitting; omitting it makes the pre-merge check fail and the ticket reopen. The Owner-line pre-merge check runs only at merge time, so after editing such a document confirm its first line with `cat -A` before calling submit_report.

[Fact w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"agenium"}) Agenium's submit_report tool takes the fields ticket_id, summary, acceptance, artifacts, extension, risks, follow_ups and confidence; passing a field such as `description` is rejected as invalid_arguments.
[Fact w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) In the docs project, ticket work happens in a git worktree under .agenium/worktrees/<ticket-id> on branch agenium/<ticket-id>.

[Lesson w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) In the docs project, satisfying the ticket's acceptance criteria and passing self-review is not enough: project-wide document conventions enforced by pre-merge checks must also be honoured.

[Fact w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) The docs project's pre-merge check fails if a document in deliverables/ or reports/ does not start with the exact 'Owner: <team-name>' line, even when the ticket's acceptance criteria are met.
